title: parseConfig() — API Reference
text: parseConfig() — API Reference Docs / API / parseConfig parseConfig(text, options?) Reads a configuration file and returns a frozen object. Unknown keys are an error unless options.strict is false . Parameters Name Type Description text string The file's contents. options { strict?: boolean } Defaults to { strict: true } . Example const cfg = parseConfig(readFileSync('app.toml', 'utf8')); if (cfg.port < 1024 && !cfg.root) throw new Error('privileged port'); console.log(`listening on ${cfg.port}`); Errors ConfigSyntaxError — the text is not valid TOML. ConfigKeyError — an unknown key with strict on. Note: HTML in values is kept verbatim: bold stays as typed. Last updated 2026-09-30 · Edit this page
